title: MetricValue
description: A single metric data point with statistical values for a time period.

startTimeInMillis.description: The start time of this data point in Unix epoch milliseconds.

occurrences.description: The number of observations in this time period.

current.description: The current or last observed value.

min.description: The minimum value observed in this time period.

max.description: The maximum value observed in this time period.

sum.description: The sum of all values in this time period.

value.description: The computed value based on the rollup type.

standardDeviation.description: The standard deviation of values in this time period.
